text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please... Hang in there, 
C.B....!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We won the Satsuki Sho! If we take this 
one, we're one step away from the Triple 
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, however... when it comes to the 
Derby, there's a jinx known as the Derby 
Position.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
If you can't get into the top ten by the 
first corner, winning will be extremely 
difficult, but...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Since CB's running style is an end-closer, 
it might be a bit tough for her.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! CB's totally gonna break a 
jinx like that!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! She has enough talent to become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume, so she's 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Can Mr. C.B. become a Triple Crown 
Umamusume? Ever since the Satsuki Sho, the 
racecourse has been buzzing with 
unprecedented anticipation—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Many are saying it's an impossible feat. 
Yet if anyone can defy conventional 
wisdom, it has to be her. Such voices can 
definitely be heard in the crowd!”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. This "Weekly Pakatto Channel" sure 
plays favorites with me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A legendary Triple Crown Umamusume, huh... 
Everyone really wants to see one.

"The moment a Triple Crown Umamusume is 
born. Most spectators in this generation 
have likely never seen it. Even so—"
It's not what Mr. C.B. herself desires.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you sure you should be saying 
that? Making such a bold claim, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, just kidding. Only you would say 
something like that."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'm gonna run however I want. Just 
being myself, the way I do it.

With the entire grandstand watching with 
bated breath—the curtain rose on the Japan 
Derby.
